subject: improve format for hashtableDump (#3081)
reason: The change only reworks printf formatting inside hashtableDump, a debug dump helper in src/hashtable.c. The function is not called from any server code path — its only reference besides the definition is a forward declaration in the unit test file src/unit/test_hashtable.c — so no command reply, data structure behaviour, replication, or persistence path is affected. It is a cosmetic developer-tooling change with no observable behaviour to test, so no scenario is needed.
